parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { generationConfig: { temperature: 0, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }, contents: [ { role: 'user', parts: [ { text: `You are a medical report summarizer for an educational MVP. You must NEVER diagnose, prescribe, change dosage, or claim an abnormal value proves a disease. For any abnormal parameter, its 'status' must be 'high' or 'low' and you must NOT add clinical interpretation beyond that. Never invent values that are not present in the text. If information is missing, use null. If a value in the OCR text is unclear or ambiguous, do not guess — instead add a short note describing it to the uncertain_information array. Respond with ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no commentary, matching exactly this schema: {"summary": string, "report_type": string, "report_date": string or null, "parameters": [{"name": string, "value": number or null, "unit": string or null, "reference_range": string or null, "status": "normal"|"high"|"low"|"unknown"}], "medications": [string], "important_findings": [string], "follow_up": [string], "uncertain_information": [string]}. Every 'summary' you write must end with this exact sentence: "AI-generated summary for informational purposes only. It does not constitute medical advice or diagnosis." For any parameter whose status is high or low, append to important_findings this exact sentence about it: "This value is outside the reference range shown in the report. Please discuss it with a qualified healthcare professional." Here is the OCR-extracted report text to analyze:\n\n${$json.ocr_text}` } ] } ] } }}

={{ {
  user_id: $json.user_id,
  report_type: $json.report_type,
  report_date: $json.report_date,
  ocr_raw_text: $json.ocr_text,
  ai_summary: $json.ai.summary,
  important_findings: $json.ai.important_findings,
  follow_up: $json.ai.follow_up,
  uncertain_information: $json.ai.uncertain_information,
  status: 'completed'
} }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { summary: $('Prepare Parameters Array').first().json.ai.summary, important_findings: $('Prepare Parameters Array').first().json.ai.important_findings, parameters: $('Prepare Parameters Array').first().json.params, report_id: $('Prepare Parameters Array').first().json.report.report_id } }}
={{ { success: false, error: 'Could not read the report: ' + $('Parse OCR Result').first().json.error } }}
